r01.title: Process personal data only on consent or a permitted use

r02.title: Give a standalone, itemised notice before asking for consent

r03.title: Notify people who consented before the Act took effect

r04.title: Offer notice and consent in English or a scheduled language

r05.title: Make consent free, specific, informed and unambiguous

r06.title: Show a contact person in every consent request

r07.title: Let people withdraw consent as easily as they gave it

r08.title: On withdrawal, stop processing and make processors stop

r09.title: Be able to prove notice and consent

r10.title: Use voluntarily provided data only for the stated purpose

r11.title: Accept consent given or withdrawn through a Consent Manager

r12.title: Gate every outbound send on consent at send time

r13.title: Summarise data held, processing and who received it

r14.title: Correct, complete and update personal data on request

r15.title: Erase on request unless needed for the purpose or by law

r16.title: Run a published grievance mechanism, answering within 90 days

r17.title: Let people nominate someone to act on death or incapacity

r18.title: Publish how to make a request and which identifier is needed

r19.title: Publish a contact and include it in every response

r20.title: Verify identity, rate limit and audit rights requests

r21.title: Keep data accurate and complete where it drives decisions

r22.title: Honour rights of the platform's own staff, billing contacts and visitors

r23.title: Erase data when consent is withdrawn or the purpose ends

r24.title: Erase inactive data after three years, with 48 hours' notice

r25.title: Keep personal data and logs for at least one year

r27.title: Protect data with encryption, masking or tokens

r29.title: Log and monitor access to personal data

r30.title: Back up data so processing can continue after a loss

r31.title: Keep logs for one year to detect and investigate incidents

r32.title: Have a security clause in every processor contract

r33.title: Be able to show the security measures in place

r34.title: Keep reasonable security safeguards in general

r35.title: Control AI paths that send contact text to third parties

r36.title: Tell each affected person about a breach without delay

r37.title: Tell the Board of a breach, then report within 72 hours

r38.title: As processor, tell the tenant of a breach fast enough

r39.title: Get verifiable parental consent before processing a child's data

r40.title: No tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted ads for children

r41.title: Apply the Fourth Schedule exemptions for child-data duties

r42.title: Respect Government limits on transfers of data abroad

r43.title: Stay responsible for what processors do

r44.title: Meet Significant Data Fiduciary duties, only if notified

r45.title: Produce evidence for a Board inquiry within six months

r46.title: Keep the platform's own notices, terms acceptance and cookie choice

r47.title: Name a platform contact and grievance route

attest.title: Record a statement
